paragraphs.text: The Domains is a rather vaguely-defined geographical region on Dominaria , which includes the continent of Aerona , and the archipelago to its east, effectively including all landmasses west of Corondor .

It is a few thousand miles west of Corondor , across the Western Sea , and lies six thousand miles east of the Terisian Isles . The Domains is the home of many of Dominaria's most famous cultures, including Benalia , Llanowar , Verdura , Keld , Hurloon , and the White Knights . Some time before the Phyrexian Invasion, the Domains were part of a series of campaigns known as the Island Wars.
The Domains include all the islands lying off the continent of Aerona, west of Corondor , including:
Aerona - A continent, by far the largest landmass of the Domains - see the Aerona page for more specific locations.
Aldon's Castle - an ancient castle somewhere in the Western Domains.
Askaranton - conquered by Keld
Avenant - an island of archers and poets, considered part of Benalia

The Burning Isles - an archipelago of volcanic islands north of Jamuraa Bogardan - an island of lava, hellkites and fire magic Steel Island - an island of mechanised life Urborg - an island of murky swamps The City of Urborg - destroyed ages ago by Nevinyrral The Martyrs' Tomb - a memorial to fallen heroes The Nethermire - fetid tar pits Skulltown - a town in the swamps of Urborg The Stronghold - base of operations for the Cabal The Tomb of Flesh , a Phyrexian structure of unknown purpose, is located within a lake. Vhelnish - underground city, former home of Dralnu Yavimayan Colony - transplanted on the island by Multani , this piece of forest is still present in Urborg
Equitar - a location about 1500 miles from Estark .
Esturin - a small archipelago west of Aerona, known for cultivating pomegranates
Etlan Shiis - a Vodalian merfolk colony east of Aerona
Foriys - an island east of southern Aerona
Glenar - home to Black Elves . Red Donald fought off the elves and took control of a dragon whelp there.
Icehaven - the largest island outside Aerona - see the Icehaven page for more specific locations.
Kieve - an island north of Orvada Kieve Beach - A beach on the shore
Kish - a small island between Aerona and Oneah, known for its precious tapestries, woven with gold and silver thread by the Naki weavers.
Mors Ridge - a mountain ridge where Palladia-Mors once slept

Oneah - an island which once hosted a nation of the same name, once famous for its scholars and martial artists Amjad - a region of foul and blighted bogs Plains of Oneah - the wide flatlans where the Cities of the Sun used to lie Red Mountains - mountain range running along the middle of the island Savaea - a forest of elves The Emperor Oak - an ancient tree, sacred to the elves Shanodin - a forest of dryads Heart of Shanodin - a magical glade that reveals one's true self

Orvada - an empire covering an archipelago in the far eastern part of the Domains Denawa - the northern main island of Orvada Walassa - the southern main island of Orvada Lucassa - a city famous for its lighthouse Orvada City - houses a campus of the Tolarian Academy
Ru-nora - an island containing descendants of the Thran Teezlan tower - a watchtower Temple of Xenporo - a holy site
Sardnia - an island in the Voda Sea
The Spice Isles - an archipelago of western islands, a Benalish colony Tolaria West - site of one of the Tolarian Academy 's campuses
Stahaan - an island of minotaurs - see the Stahaan page for more specific locations.
Uthden - a lush land of trolls , located somewhere in the Domains.
Varnalca - a southern island known for its cultivation of oranges. Also famous for its long period of peace in its farmlands and the elven alliance that extended it.
Verdura - an enchanted, verdant island just off the coast of southern Aerona
Vesuva - an island known for its shapeshifters
White Island - where the sorceress Dwen hailed from
Yulin - a location about 1500 miles from Estark .

The Domains also contain several seas notorious for the inconsistencies in descriptions of different geographers. While on one map the Voda Sea is very small and contains only several islands, on another map it stretches so far it contains almost all the eastern Spice Isles. The latter is also depicted on the map that is considered to be the most accurate. Another example is the Honeyed Sea which is (mistakenly) located east of Avenant on one map, but south of the Green Lands on another. This waterbody is absent on the mentioned map.
The Flowing Seas - somewhere off the coast of southern Aerona

The Honeyed Sea - south of Aerona , with shores on Verdura , Barbar , Foriys and Varnalca in the north, and Ru-Nora and Sardnia in the south. On the 1999 map of Aerona the Honeyed Sea is erroneously placed west of Hurloon .
The Howling Sea - separaing the Domains from the Northland
Kukemssa Sea - separating the Domains from Jamuraa
The Rip - a strait separating Icehaven from Aerona
The Sea of Avenant - between Avenant and Aerona
The Sea of Fire - between Aerona and the Spice Isles
The Sea of Whales - east of northern Aerona
The Visceral Sea - west of the Spice Isles, separating the Domains from the Terisian Isles
The Videnthian Sea - northwest of Icehaven and the Spice Isles

The Voda Sea - home to several merfolk kingdom, bordering to the Burning Isles Cosiman Reefs - a separate northeastern merfolk colony, protected by Metathran The Coral Caves - the part of Cosiman that breaks the surface of the ocean, creating waves Vodalia - the largest empire on the plane
The map of Aerona from 2018 includes some of the nearby Domains
